name: Mermaid
description: An open-source JavaScript diagram renderer that turns Markdown-like text into flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, and other visuals.
editorialNote: Imported from the UMLChina UML tools collection. The English summary is a concise editorial translation; capability fields remain Unknown unless the source explicitly states support.
sourceDescriptionZh: 使用类似Markdown的语法描述图形，并由JavaScript渲染。支持流程图、序列图、类图、状态图、ER图。12.0开始支持用例图。
classificationNotes: This record covers the MIT-licensed Mermaid renderer. Mermaid Chart is a separate commercial service.
